article.context:
Sky Star implemented a comprehensive pest control program for a hotel property in Madinah, covering guest rooms, kitchens, and back-of-house areas. The program combined room-by-room bed bug inspection using thermal imaging and flashlights, targeted cockroach and rodent control in kitchens and storage areas, and AC duct disinfection throughout guest floors — all carried out using equipment and materials licensed by the Saudi Ministry of Health.

Ongoing monitoring and scheduled follow-up visits were put in place to maintain results without disrupting hotel operations or guest experience.
article.subtitle: A full pest management program for a hotel property — termite, cockroach, bed bug, and rodent control using licensed methods and materials.
article.title: Hotel Pest Control Program

article.context:
نفذت النجم السماوي برنامجاً متكاملاً لمكافحة الآفات في منشأة فندقية بالمدينة المنورة، شمل الغرف والمطابخ ومناطق الخدمة. تضمن البرنامج فحص الغرف للكشف عن بق الفراش باستخدام الكاميرات الحرارية والمصابيح الكاشفة، ومكافحة مستهدفة للصراصير والقوارض في المطابخ ومناطق التخزين، وتعقيم مجاري الهواء في جميع طوابق الفندق — باستخدام معدات ومواد مرخصة من وزارة الصحة السعودية.

تم وضع خطة متابعة ومراقبة دورية للحفاظ على النتائج دون التأثير على سير عمل الفندق أو تجربة النزلاء.
article.subtitle: برنامج متكامل لمكافحة الآفات في منشأة فندقية — يشمل مكافحة النمل الأبيض والصراصير وبق الفراش والقوارض باستخدام أساليب ومواد مرخصة.
article.title: برنامج مكافحة الآفات في فندق

article.context:
Working with a residential villa under construction, Sky Star applied a full pre-construction termite protection program: soil treatment around the foundation trenches, drilling and injecting termiticide along interior baseboards, and installing protective barriers before final flooring was laid.

The team followed up with a post-construction inspection to confirm the treated areas remained protected and free of termite activity.
article.subtitle: Pre- and post-construction termite treatment for a residential villa, including soil injection and protective barrier installation.
article.title: Residential Villa Termite Protection

article.context:

وتابع الفريق بعد ذلك بفحص ما بعد البناء للتأكد من استمرار حماية المناطق المعالجة وخلوها من أي نشاط للنمل الأبيض.
article.subtitle: معالجة النمل الأبيض قبل وبعد البناء لفيلا سكنية، شملت حقن التربة وتركيب حواجز واقية.
article.title: حماية فيلا سكنية من النمل الأبيض

article.context:
Sky Star carried out an integrated rodent control program for a residential building, starting with a full inspection to identify entry points and rodent activity around parking areas and utility rooms. Entry points were sealed, bait stations were placed at key locations, and traps were used in areas where children and pets were present.

Regular follow-up visits confirmed the property remained rodent-free after the initial treatment.
article.subtitle: An integrated rodent control program for a residential building — sealing entry points, bait station placement, and ongoing monitoring.
article.title: Residential Rodent Control Program

أكدت زيارات المتابعة الدورية خلو المبنى من القوارض بعد المعالجة الأولية.

article.title: برنامج مكافحة القوارض في مبنى سكني

article.context:
Sky Star provided a full sanitization service for a restaurant kitchen, using SFDA-approved disinfectants and equipment suited to a working food preparation environment. The service covered food prep surfaces, storage areas, and drainage points, alongside pest-proofing measures around pipework and wall openings.

The eco-friendly materials used left no harmful residue, allowing the kitchen to resume normal operations shortly after treatment.
article.subtitle: Eco-friendly sanitization and disinfection for a restaurant kitchen, using SFDA-approved materials safe for a food preparation environment.

article.context:

A scheduled maintenance plan was set up to keep insect activity low through the warmer months.

article.context:
Sky Star deployed its ™ICP infection control program across a multi-floor office building, disinfecting shared workstations, meeting rooms, and high-touch surfaces such as door handles and elevator buttons. The program was scheduled outside business hours to avoid disrupting employees, with laboratory testing used to verify effectiveness after treatment.
